abstract: PURPOSE: Orchiectomy followed by infradiaphragmatic irradiation is the standard treatment for Stage I-II testicular seminoma in The Netherlands. Because body image and sexual functioning can be affected by treatment, a retrospective study was carried out to assess treatment outcome, body image, and changes in sexuality after orchiectomy and radiotherapy. METHODS AND MATERIALS: The medical charts of 166 patients with Stage I-II testicular seminoma were reviewed. A questionnaire on body image and current sexual functioning regarding the frequency and quality of erections, sexual activity, significance of sex, and changes in sexuality was sent to 157 patients (at a mean of 51 months after treatment). RESULTS: Seventy-eight percent (n = 123, mean age 42 years) completed the questionnaire. During irradiation, almost half of patients experienced nausea and 19% nausea and vomiting. Only 3 patients had disease relapse. After treatment, about 20% reported less interest and pleasure in sex and less sexual activity. Interest in sex, erectile difficulties, and satisfaction with sexual life did not differ from age-matched healthy controls. At the time of the survey, 17% of patients had erectile difficulties, a figure that was significantly higher than before treatment, but which correlated also with age. Twenty percent expressed concerns about fertility, and 52% found their body had changed after treatment. Cancer treatment had negatively influenced sexual life in 32% of the patients. CONCLUSIONS: Orchiectomy with radiotherapy is an effective and well-tolerated treatment for Stage I-II testicular seminoma. Treatment-induced changes in body image and concerns about fertility were detected, but the sexual problems encountered did not seem to differ from those of healthy controls, although baseline data are lacking.
abstract_ja:
目的：病期I–II精巣セミノーマに対する精巣摘除術に続く横隔膜下照射は、オランダの標準治療である。治療は身体イメージや性機能に影響しうるため、精巣摘除術と放射線療法後の治療成績、身体イメージ、性生活の変化を評価する後方視的研究を行った。
方法と材料：病期I–II精巣セミノーマの患者166例のカルテを検討した。勃起の頻度と質、性行為の頻度、性の重要性、性生活の変化に関する質問票を157例に送付した（治療後平均51か月）。
結果：78%（123例、平均年齢42歳）が回答した。照射中、約半数が悪心を、19%が悪心と嘔吐を経験した。再発は3例のみだった。治療後、約20%が性への関心と快楽の低下、性行為の減少を報告した。性への関心、勃起困難、性生活への満足度は、年齢をマッチさせた健常対照と差がなかった。調査時点で17%が勃起困難を有し、治療前より有意に高かったが、年齢とも相関していた。20%が妊孕性への懸念を表明し、52%が治療後に身体が変化したと感じていた。がん治療により性生活が悪影響を受けたと答えた患者は32%だった。
結論：精巣摘除術と放射線療法は、病期I–II精巣セミノーマに対して有効で忍容性の良い治療である。治療に伴う身体イメージの変化と妊孕性への懸念が認められた。性的問題は健常対照と差がないように見えたが、ベースラインデータが不足している。
